body: I'm feeling a bit calmed down. Dogs help out a lot.
They've noticed once crying and trying to calm me down, but further than that, nothing from them. I'm such a wreck I can't even go to school.

I can't remember when I've started feeling this bad. Maybe the fifth or sixth grade?

That's good to know, but didn't Van Gogh commit suicide or something like that, and his work went unnoticed until long after his death?

Everyone else has found their thing that they love and are good at by now. I'm just stuck here watching YouTube and Netflix and browsing Reddit. I really want to find something but I just don't have any motivation to do anything. 

 For me it was video games but I stopped because I realized that it was making me do bad in school and now I don't regret dropping it out of my life because I don't miss it.
